SELECT
                p.id AS id,
                s.store_name AS store_name,
                pap.id AS parent_id,
                p.id AS child_id,
                pap.product AS product,
                pap.erp_product AS erp_product,
                c.category AS category,
                HO.attr_val AS variant,
                ps.stock AS inventory,
                pg.gtin AS gtin
            FROM
                products p
                    JOIN
                products AS pap ON pap.id = (CASE
                    WHEN p.parent_prod_id > 0 THEN p.parent_prod_id
                    ELSE p.id
                END)
                    JOIN
                product_store AS paps ON paps.product_id = (CASE
                    WHEN p.parent_prod_id > 0 THEN p.parent_prod_id
                    ELSE p.id
                END)
                    LEFT JOIN
                categories AS c ON (c.id = (SELECT
                        cat_id
                    FROM
                        has_categories
                    WHERE
                        prod_id = pap.id
                            AND cat_id NOT IN (162 , 148)
                    ORDER BY CASE
                        WHEN cat_id = 153 THEN FIELD(153, cat_id)
                        ELSE id
                    END
                    LIMIT 1))
                    LEFT JOIN
                products_warehouses AS pw ON (pw.product_id = p.id)
                    LEFT JOIN
                has_options AS HO ON HO.prod_id = p.id
                    LEFT JOIN
                attributes AS A ON (A.id = HO.attr_id
                    AND A.attr LIKE '%%Size')
                    LEFT JOIN
                products_gs1 pg ON p.id = pg.product_id
                    JOIN
                users_artists ua ON ua.id = pap.added_by
                    LEFT JOIN
                product_store AS ps ON (ps.product_id = p.id)
                    LEFT JOIN
                stores AS s ON (s.id = ps.store_id)
            WHERE
                (p.prod_type = 1 or p.prod_type = 4 or p.prod_type = 5) AND paps.is_del = 0
                    AND ps.is_del = 0
                    AND s.id IS NOT NULL
